sections.label: Captive seafarer employment protections
sections.summary: A seafarer's employment agreement continues during captivity, with wages and entitlements paid until release and repatriation or death, and the employer must repatriate the seafarer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Should a seafarer be held captive on or off a ship as a result of an act of piracy and armed robbery against the ship, the seafarer's employment agreement continues to have effect during the period of captivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Further, a captive seafarer's wages and entitlements must continue to be paid during the period of captivity, until the day the seafarer is released and duly repatriated, or until the seafarer's death while in captivity.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The seafarer's employer is also obligated to repatriate the seafarer upon release from captivity.

sections.label: Singapore Strait sea robbery incidents
sections.summary: CNA reported sea robbery incidents in the Singapore Strait hit a four-year high in 2019 with 31 incidents, compared to 17 from 2016 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: CNA also reported that sea robbery incidents in the Singapore Strait had hit a four-year high in 2019, with a grand total of 31 such incidents, which is in stark contrast to the 17 reported incidents from 2016 to 2018.

sections.label: 2016 Maritime Labour Convention amendments
sections.summary: In 2016, laws were amended per the Maritime Labour Convention to protect crew abandoned by shipowners by mandating shipowners' financial security.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In 2016, we amended our laws in accordance with the Maritime Labour Convention or MLC, to improve protections for crew abandoned by their shipowners by mandating shipowners' procuring of financial security.

sections.label: Wages during seafarer captivity
sections.summary: New section 20(7A) provides that a seafarer's wages and other entitlements must continue to be paid during captivity until release and repatriation or death.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The new section 20(7A) provides that the seafarer's wages and other entitlements must continue to be paid during the seafarer's period of captivity until the seafarer's release and repatriation, or the date of the seafarer's death.

sections.label: Abu Sayyaf fishermen kidnapping
sections.summary: In June 2019, 10 gunmen from Abu Sayyaf kidnapped 10 fishermen off the coast of Sabah, Malaysia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Most recently, in June 2019, 10 gunmen from Abu Sayyaf kidnapped 10 fishermen off the coast of Sabah, Malaysia.

sections.label: Bill aligns with MLC amendments
sections.summary: The Bill will align Singapore with the 2018 amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention, addressing protections and recourse available.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: If not, what protections and recourse are available to them?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This Bill will align Singapore with the 2018 amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention or MLC.

sections.label: False shipboard security incident reports
sections.summary: Knowingly or recklessly making a false shipboard security incident report is an offence punishable by fine up to $10,000, imprisonment up to two years, or both.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: A shipowner who knowingly or recklessly makes a false report of a shipboard security incident commits an offence under section 194 of the Merchant Shipping Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Such an offence is punishable with a fine not exceeding $10,000, or an imprisonment term not exceeding two years, or both.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The intent of the amendment is that the shipowner must continue to pay the wages of the captive seafarer until the seafarer is released from captivity and repatriated or until the death of the seafarer while in captivity.

sections.label: Wages for captive seafarers
sections.summary: The 2018 amendments require shipowners of Singapore-registered ships to keep paying captive seafarers' wages and entitlements until release and repatriation or death.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The 2018 amendments will require shipowners of Singapore-registered ships to continue to honour the employment agreements of seafarers who have been taken captive by pirates or armed robbers regardless of whether the date fixed for the expiry of the seafarer's employment agreement has passed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Shipowners will be obliged to continue paying captive seafarers their wages and entitlements until the seafarers are released from captivity and repatriated, or until the seafarer's death, should the seafarer die while in captivity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This would allow the seafarer's next-of-kin to seek compensation from shipowners for wages during the period of captivity.
